blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Cedar Hills rose from 7 in June to 9 in October (+28.6%), and 4 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 0.6% of Surrey’s 1,434 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Cedar Hills?
Cedar Hills also had 51 houses listed and 14 sold in October, against 9 condos and townhomes listed. The Cedar Hills houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Cedar Hills home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

8 townhomes sold in Cedar Hills with a median price of $817,500 (the middle half sold between $798,750 and $841,250), taking a median of 20 days to sell at 98.9% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $596 per square foot, a median year built of 2025 and a median strata fee of $334 a month. 6 condos sold in Cedar Hills with a median price of $325,900, taking a median of 28 days to sell at 94.8% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $426 per square foot, a median year built of 1984 and a median strata fee of $350 a month.

Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Cedar Hills?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 9 condos and townhomes listed in Cedar Hills. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Cedar Hills a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Cedar Hills had a sales ratio of not published for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Cedar Hills from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 4 condos and townhomes sold in Cedar Hills over those 5 months, out of 737 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Cedar Hills sell for?
faq.a: 8 townhomes sold in Cedar Hills between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $817,500.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Cedar Hills?
faq.a: The median was 20 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.9% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
